checksum/adler32#

Adler-32 of an immutable byte chunk continued from an unsigned 32-bit seed.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let prefix = Adler32([byte(87), byte(105), byte(107), byte(105)]);
let whole = prefix.state([byte(112), byte(101), byte(100), byte(105), byte(97)]);
whole.checksum(); // 300286872 ("Wikipedia"); prefix remains unchanged

Description#

Adler-32 of an immutable byte chunk continued from an unsigned 32-bit seed. Adler32() and Adler32(bytes) use seed 1. Adler32(origin: bytes, initial: initial) rejects seeds outside 0..4294967295 with InvalidChecksumInitial at construction.

checksum() computes lazily, without mutation or memoization. It returns the non-negative packed sums of RFC 1950, each modulo 65521. Empty input yields 1 by default; both halves of an explicit seed are normalized even when empty, matching zlib. Per-byte reduction bounds intermediate arithmetic. state(bytes) evaluates this chunk and returns a successor retaining only the new chunk and resulting seed. Repeated queries and independent branches are valid. Immutable input arrays are borrowed; no streams/resources are closed. Runtime is linear in the observed chunk. This is not a cryptographic digest; encode strings explicitly before passing their bytes.
